meta.title: Inputs for estimating TSMC revenue per fab per year

units.capacity: wafers per month unless stated; 12-inch equivalent = 8-inch-eq / 2.25 (TSMC factor); 6-inch -> 8-inch-eq: /1.78 (TSMC factor, from 2013 x0.5625)

meta.how_to_use: monthly revenue x quarter's wafer-revenue node mix (node_share_quarterly) x (1 - non-wafer share) gives wafer revenue per node per month; multiply by node_fab_share fractions to get revenue per fab; add advanced packaging revenue (packaging) allocated to AP sites. TSMC does not publish per-fab revenue; every per-fab number derived this way is an estimate.
meta.basis_caveat: Before 2006 monthly figures are parent-company (unconsolidated); 1998-2012 annual consolidated figures are ROC GAAP; IFRS from 2012/2013. Node mixes are % of WAFER revenue (excludes mask, design, and since 2017 packaging/testing).

Best proxies: fab capacity (fabs.capacity_year_end_8inch_eq for 1998-1999) and wafer size: 1987-1994 all 6-inch (Fab 1 from 1987, Fab 2 from 1990); first 8-inch fab (Fab 3) 1995; 1996-1997 annual report: 0.35um in volume 1997, 0.3um late 1997, 0.25um from early 1998. bucket_notes: Bucket definitions change over time: 0.15 and 0.18um merged from 2015 (reclassified); 0.25/0.35/0.5um merged into '>=0.25um' from 2015; 16/20nm combined 2014-2016, split 2017-2024 in 20-F (quarterly reports merged them again from 1Q25).
From 2017 packaging and testing revenue was reclassified from wafer revenue to non-wafer revenue (2015-2016 restated in the FY2017 20-F; earlier years not restated).
Years 2003-2005 in the 20-F used '<=0.13um'/'<=0.09um' cumulative buckets as labelled.
1999-2000 percentages include affiliates/JVs in the quarterly reports; 20-F annual figures are TSMC consolidated.
